{{short description|German mathematician}}
'''Heike Fassbender''' is a German mathematician specializing in [[numerical linear algebra]]. She is a professor in the Institute for Computational Mathematics at the [[Technical University of Braunschweig]], and the president for the 2017–2019 term of the [[Gesellschaft für Angewandte Mathematik und Mechanik]] (GAMM, the International Association of Applied Mathematics and Mechanics).{{r|gamm}}

==Education and career==
Fassbender earned a master's degree in computer science at the [[University at Buffalo]],{{r|ihk}} and completed her Ph.D. at the [[University of Bremen]] in 1992. Her dissertation, ''Numerische Verfahren zur diskreten trigonometrischen Polynomapproximation'', was jointly supervised by [[Angelika Bunse-Gerstner]] and Ludwig F. Elsner.{{r|mg}}

Fassbender moved to the [[Technical University of Munich]] in 2000.{{r|nad}}
She joined the Technical University of Braunschweig faculty in 2002, 
and was vice president for teaching, studies, and further education at the university from 2008 to 2012.{{r|ihk}}

==Book==
Fassbender is the author of the book ''Symplectic Methods for the Symplectic Eigenproblem'' (Kluwer, 2002).{{r|sm}}

==Professional service==
As president of GAMM, Fassbender became the first woman to lead GAMM.{{r|ihk}}
As well as her presidency of GAMM, Fassbender was appointed for a four-year term on the German Accreditation Council in 2018.{{r|ak}} Moreover, she is treasurer of the International Council for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (ICIAM) is a worldwide organisation for professional applied mathematics societies, and for other societies with a significant interest in industrial or applied mathematics. January 1st, 2023, Fassbender is elected a chair member of the [[SIAM]] Council.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Welcoming the Newest Electees to the SIAM Board of Trustees and Council |url=https://sinews.siam.org/Details-Page/welcoming-the-newest-electees-to-the-siam-board-of-trustees-and-council |access-date=2023-03-27 |website=SIAM News |date=23 January 2023 |language=en-US}}</ref>
